attributes.input.value: GOVERN 1.3 (action GV-1.3-002) in the NIST GAI Profile recommends establishing minimum performance/assurance thresholds before deployment approval. Which specific purpose-built NIST testing environment does MEASURE 2.3 (action MS-2.3-004) recommend using to empirically evaluate GAI trustworthy characteristics?
attributes.output.value:
GOVERN 1.3 (action GV-1.3-002) recommends establishing minimum performance/assurance thresholds before deployment approval, while MEASURE 2.3 (action MS-2.3-004) recommends utilizing a purpose-built testing environment such as NIST Dioptra to empirically evaluate GAI trustworthy characteristics.

NIST Dioptra is the specific purpose-built testing environment recommended for this empirical evaluation.
